caption: The drawing is primarily composed of graphite pencil on a beige or light tan paper background. The central and largest object is a lidded tankard depicted in high detail with three engraved bands at the base, a decorated, scalloped edge on the lid, and a rounded handle with a thumb lever. On the top surface of the lid, there is an ornate circular design. Above the tankard are three smaller elements: to the left is a side view of a tankard without a lid, showing its basic outline and handle; to the right is an outline of a tankard seen from the back, displaying a simplified view of the handle and a single vertical design element. In the center above the tankard is a shield-shaped coat of arms with four sections, decorative embellishments, and a banner below that reads "TENAX PROPOSITI." Additional ornamental elements appear above the shield, including a thistle and leaf motif. The pencil shading is used to give form, contrast, and texture to all objects, with the tankard being highly detailed and shaded to indicate its metallic surface, while the upper sketches and the coat of arms are outlined with less shading for clarity.
title: Silver Tankard
